reason: Both Claude blind-adjudicator judgments returned leak: true with zero tool calls. Their own reasoning names the cause: the task did not give the three labelled lines (Input file:, Packet file:, Repository root:) and the input and packet were Markdown files (adjudicate.AB.md, packet.md under x5/), while the role's contract (.claude/agents/blind-adjudicator.md) accepts only an input named *.AB.json or *.BA.json under adjudication-inputs/ and a .json packet under packets/. This is the coordinator's wiring, not a leak: no file was read.
decision: Attempt 1 decides nothing. Attempt 2 re-runs all four adjudications (two GPT-6 runner jobs, two blind-adjudicators) on one contract-conforming JSON input per order and one JSON packet, carrying the same items, returns and rules.
